g.text: Three A peaks and three B peaks, each with height 1. B occurs 10 bp downstream of each A peak.
Signed lags shown (−40 to +40 bp): use --signed-lags. At +10 bp, a 640 bp region has 630 possible A/B pairs.
A peak at +10 bp means B repeatedly occurs 10 bp downstream of A in the active coordinate orientation.
